Agent answered: signed version applies, and clarified 南京银行 template 第十三条第3款 变更条款 — changes only apply to new loans, existing loans unaffected. So the goal of clarifying version/scope is largely met.

Agent initially said "南京银行这份我没查到同样明确的变更表述" — wrong, then corrected in turn 3 when customer pushed. That's a factual error in turn 2 (claimed not found). But then corrected. Facts dimension: turn 2 statement "南京银行这份我没查到同样明确的变更表述" — that's a claim about absence of clause, which conflicts with the material available later. Is this a factual error? The agent said it didn't find; actually the clause exists. It's an unverified absolute claim that turned out wrong. Then self-corrected. Also turn 4: agent said "短信已经发出去了，里面是度小满 App 的下载入口" — but claimed it would let customer see the 协议原文 in App, which turned out wrong; customer says received download link, not agreement link. Agent admitted "我这边只能发 App 下载短信，没法直接发协议原文链接，是我刚才说错了." So there was a false promise of sending original link — actually in turn 2/3 agent offered "把原文链接发到您手机上" and then sent a download SMS. That's a mismatch between promised and delivered — factual/execution error, though agent corrected at end and gave website.

Facts score: key facts about 第十三条 were eventually accurate with source. But two errors: initially denying existence of the change clause (then corrected), and misrepresenting the SMS content / promising original link. Facts: 3? The final answer is accurate and sourced. Errors were corrected in-call. Maybe 3-4. Err: turn 2's "没查到" was hedged ("我没查到") — it's a statement of search result, not necessarily false... but it's a claim of absence; customer pushed, and agent found it. That's an unverified negative stated with confidence suggesting conclusion. Turn 4 claim that SMS contains link to view original text — false. So facts 3.

Goal: The core deliverable — clarify version and what needs to be verified. Agent answered change clause applies only to new loans, signed version governs. Then final fallback gave official website. Goal largely achieved, with minor gap (didn't deliver actual link, but agent can't; provided website path). I'd give goal 4.

Answer: customer's questions all addressed; final question "确认下发的对不对" — agent confirmed it sent download SMS not link, apologized, explained limitation, gave website. That's complete. Answer 4 or 5. Slight: agent didn't verify receipt status? It did confirm. I'd say 4 — the resolution: customer must search website himself; that's a reasonable next step. Answer 5? The key questions handled completely: version scope, change clause, delivery correction. I'd give 4-5. Minor: in turn 2 the answer was incomplete/wrong requiring customer to push again — but that counts under answer too? The final state resolved. I'll give 4.

Tone: polite, acknowledges errors ("我上次说错了，跟您更正一下"), no defensiveness. Natural. 4.

Facts: 3.

第十二条 债权债务的转让未经贷款人书面同意,借款人不得将本协议项下的权利和义务转让给任何第三方。贷款人有权无需征得借款人的同意而将本协议项下的权利和义务全部或部分转让给第三方。贷款人可采用在自有网站公告、公开媒体或本协议第十七条第1 款所约定的收件地址和送达方式通知借款人上述债权转让行为。借款人同意贷款人可自行或委托受让人代为履行债权转让通知的义务。借款人应按照本协议的约定向贷款人及/或其受让人继续承担责任。
债权转让之后,借款人同意并授权贷款人有权单方面通知第三方支付公司或银行,从借款人的指定账户中自动扣划每期还款资金(包括但不限于本金、
利息、罚息、违约金等)至债权受让人指定账户。
